## About

David Alberto Vique Almeida is a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer based in Riobamba, Ecuador.
He has 5+ years of experience building AI-driven SaaS products, web and mobile apps, automation pipelines, voice agents,
and serverless cloud systems on AWS and Azure — with end-to-end ownership across frontend, backend, DevOps, and AI integrations.
He delivers production systems for US and European clients and is available for remote engagements.

He completed a triathlon (1.5 km swim · 40 km bike · 10 km run) and co-authored a research paper
published at Springer BICA 2023 (Volume 1130).
